pages.text: About $(cfg)70$() ml of blood per kg — around 4.9 l for $(cfg)70$() kg. Without bleeding it regenerates $(cfg)500$() ml per hour online.$(br2)Blood loss: pallor, weakness, fast pulse, low pressure, greying vision. Losing $(cfg)50%$() stops the heart.
Everyone has a blood type (see the medical record and blood tests). Transfuse only compatible blood.
